name: Cinnie
source:
Another Outlander, Cinnie is also from Earth! She was proclaimed an Oracle despite her constantly saying she was not one. People believed in her even more as an Oracle since her advice actually solved multiple issues with common sense. Eventually, she formed a strong bond to Eden and is one of the only people in history to have met [url=/c171800]Luminox[/url]. This helped her discover a spell to look eternally young; however, Cinnie still decided to dress up like her OC from Earth.

[In game description]
